diagnostics.label: unawaited async let
causes: `async let` handles are lexical task_group handles and must be consumed by `await` inside the same `task_group { ... }` block.

fixes.title: Rewrite this construct using the currently supported RSScript syntax.

diagnostics.label: nested async let await
causes: `await` of a task_group async-let handle must be a direct task_group statement in the v0.7 executable MVP.

fixes.title: Rewrite this construct using the currently supported RSScript syntax.
